title: Development continues on earlier and more accessible autism screening tools
summary: Researchers and clinicians continue refining tools meant to flag autism traits earlier, including mobile health apps and AI-assisted approaches such as eye-tracking and video-based classifiers. A recent consensus effort focused on the usability and acceptability of mobile screening tools, while implementation research continues to highlight gaps in provider training and consistent follow-up after a positive screen.
